Lists are enclosed in brackets and their elements and size can be changed. [Python Notes for Professionals, PDF p. 59]

Tuples are immutable, fixed-length, and cannot be updated, meaning one cannot add, modify, or remove items once initialized. [Python Notes for Professionals, PDF p. 59] [Python Notes for Professionals, PDF p. 186] [Python Notes for Professionals, PDF p. 42]

Tuples do not have append and extend methods like lists do. [Python Notes for Professionals, PDF p. 186]
